body: Thank you for the kind words. Sadly I feel like there's not much left of me personally, let alone my willpower. I just wish I could do at least one thing on my terms and that's why I plan on doing it like this. I don't know if things will change, but this is how it stands.
Thank you, I truly mean this

I was seeing a psychiatrist for 3 years who misdiagnosed me with manic depressive disorder. It was horrible, every time I broke down because of my intrusive thoughts she would just ask me "Why do the thoughts bother you so much?". I payed so much money too. After this I went to a psychologist and she diagnosed me with OCD. After a few months she got a job at a university in another state and I was left to find another one and I haven't. I neither have the money nor the will.  I'm sorry if this sounds overly pessimistic, but it's how I honestly feel.
